commit_message_on_validation:
Verified by parity only: rla_test.rs rpg_data_area_in_lock_out's
DTALOCK, whose DSPLY a simulated operator answers on the DSPLYR screen,
under native-diff. There is no IBM i value for the batch case: there an
inquiry goes to QSYSOPR and waits, and as4tainr gives a batch call no
operator by design.

Full validation on x86_64 (jsr-test-2, s7f-s2141, the snapshot with
S2.140 and S2.141): fmt, clippy (ours), debug and release tests, release
build, demo and native-diff pass. native-diff: level 2 auto 752 tests
the same as under the interpreter; level 2 rust 752 of 752 as under the
interpreter, one program refused (NATSW1, on purpose).
